reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: none of p0019, p0020, or p0047 imposes a non-compete, field-of-use, or territory restriction on Clear Capital (the Customer).

p0047 is a mutual, personnel-only non-solicit (one year, consent not unreasonably withheld), which falls outside this rule's scope (non-compete/field-of-use restraints), and p0019 expressly preserves Contractor's freedom to serve others — a restriction on neither party's business lines.

The 'Company shall not resell or make use of said property' language in p0020 is a license-scope limit on Contractor-owned IP, not a restraint on the businesses we operate or products we may buy or build; correctly triaged to IP/license review rather than NONCOMPETE.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment is proposed; the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
